'''Mort'ton''' ({{IPAc-en|jagex|m|ɔːr|-|t|ə|n}}, {{IPAc-en|m|ɔːr|t|-|t|ə|n}}{{efn|The first syllable is pronounced with a final ''t'' by [[rsw:Mod Tytn|Mod Tytn]], who originally created the name. The official Jagex pronunciation guide omits this ''t''.}}) is a small, dilapidated town in the [[Mort Myre Swamp]], inhabited by [[afflicted|afflicted humans]] and [[Loar Shade|ghostly shades]]. The town is known for the [[Shades of Mort'ton]] [[quest]] and the [[Shades of Mort'ton (minigame)|minigame of the same name]]. The [[Barrows]] burial mounds are found just to the east.

==Transportation==
Several teleports bring players into or close to Mort'ton, listed here with their arrival destination. From closest to farthest:

* {{Plink|Mort'ton teleport}} — centre of the town.
* {{plink|Minigame Teleport}} — [[Shades of Mort'ton]]. Usable once every 20 minutes.
* {{Plink|Barrows Teleport|txt=Barrows teleport}} — [[Barrows]] entrance.
* {{Plink|Morytania legs 3}} — [[Burgh de Rott]], south of the town.
* {{Plink|Fairy ring|pic=Fairy ring (Construction) icon}} {{Fairycode|bip}} — the island west of the [[Nature Grotto]]. Requires 50 [[Agility]].
* {{Plink|Fairy ring|pic=Fairy ring (Construction) icon}} {{Fairycode|bkr}} — near the [[Swamp Boaty|swamp boaty]], a small boat that [[Cyreg]] will let players ride to [[the Hollows]] for {{Coins|10}}.

==History==
{{LoreSources|Diary of Herbi Flax|Gadderanks|the1=yes|dialogue2=yes}}

Mort'ton was once a quiet market town that specialised in death, founded late in the [[Fourth Age]]. By using the natural caves underneath the town as tombs, Mort'ton became known for specializing in cremations with [[Pyre logs (disambiguation)|pyre logs]]. The town, much like others in Morytania, were later subjugated by the [[vampyre]]s and likely paid blood tithes. Unfortunately, a strange mist sent from the [[Sanguinesti region]] plagued the villagers of Mort'ton, turning them into [[afflicted]]. Despite the attempts of [[Herbi Flax]] and his assistant [[Liornish Stemplehair]], they were unable to find a permanent cure and succumbed to its infection.

The same mist also caused the remains underneath the catacombs to reanimate, though only [[Loar Shade]]s - the weakest of the six types, were found roaming the village grounds. The other five - [[Phrin Shade|Phrin]], [[Riyl Shade|Riyl]], [[Asyn Shade|Asyn]], [[Fiyr Shade|Fiyr]] and [[Urium Shade]]s, remain in the catacombs where they were interred. The shades have not been seen in the surrounding area, indicating that they were limited to the town's nearby vicinity.

The vampyres, unaware of the plague, revisited the village to obtain blood tithes. The vampyre noble [[Malak]] consumed some of the blood collected from the town, but became ill as a result. The vampyres then stopped taking tithes from the village.

During year 169 of the [[Fifth Age]], an adventurer stumbled upon the ruins of Mort'ton and discovered Herbi's diary. By using a [[serum 207]] on two prominent inhabitants, [[Ulsquire Shauncy]] and [[Razmire Keelgan]], they were able to discover how to cremate the shade remains and learned where the shades' burial place was. The adventurer later perfected a [[serum 208]] by sanctifying the serum 207 at the [[Flamtaer]] temple, thus allowing Ulsquire and Razmire to be permanently cured of the plague.

=== Shades of Mort'ton ===
North of the town is the [[Flamtaer]] temple, which players rebuild in the [[Shades of Mort'ton (minigame)|Shades of Mort'ton]] [[minigame]]. On the south and west sides of the town are [[Funeral Pyre|funeral pyres]] for burning [[shade remains]], and players can enter the dungeon just east of the Flamtaer temple to access the accompanying [[shade catacombs]].

==Inhabitants==

=== Personalities ===

* {{Chatl|Afflicted|pic=Afflicted (level 30) chathead}}, locals of the town who speak only jibberish.
* {{Chatl|Cyreg Paddlehorn}}, a [[Myreque]] associate who can ferry players north.
* {{Chatl|Dampe}}, a gravedigger who can reward players with coffins.
* {{Chatl|Mort'ton local|pic=Mort'ton local (level 30) chathead}}, locals who have been (temporarily) cured by a [[Serum 207|serum]].
* {{Chatl|Razmire Keelgan}}, a businessman who runs two convenient shops.
* {{Chatl|Strange Old Man}}, an odd man with a digging obsession.
* {{Chatl|Ulsquire Shauncy}}, the priest of Mort'ton.

=== Monsters ===
There are 25 aggressive [[Loar Shade|loar shades]] around the town. To the east, players can also take on the fearsome [[Barrows brothers]].
